reviewStatus: Accepted by primary and independent evidence reviewers on 2026-10-15; no remaining actionable finding
verdict: Real Android SSHJ trust/authentication checks and two exact finite SFTP completions; only idle window observations; no capability promotion

scope.route: Real device-to-workstation fixture through the app default socket route; no route selection or VPN bypass; underlying transport and latency not qualified

finalPermissionObservation.boundary: Final own-package permission state only; this does not test denial, revocation or continuous grant during every operation.

configuration.forcedCommand: internal-sftp with fixture directory as initial directory
configuration.containmentBoundary: Initial directory and forced SFTP do not establish chroot or general account/filesystem isolation.

providerObservation.boundary: Names/order equality only; not cryptographic provider implementation attestation or proof of no transient change between observations.

trustChecks.hostKeyLabels: Aliases replace actual fixture fingerprints; fixture-original and fixture-changed were independently compared in private artifacts.
trustChecks.noAuthenticationBoundary: Unknown and changed key journals report authenticated=false; corresponding server logs record zero accepted/failed public-key attempts and zero sessions. Reviewed engine rejects before key loading/authentication; no packet capture claimed.

evidenceCaveats: unknown-result.json revision 3 was captured while connecting; use unknown-settled.json revision 4 for terminal unknown-trust outcome.

Enrollment raises journal revision 4 to 5 without creating an attempt. The primary normal-01 log is byte-identical before and immediately after enrollment; no automatic connection is observed in that bounded interval.
enrolled-no-run-observation.json also lists a snapshot of an earlier snapshot log; that duplicate is excluded from counted primary log observations.
Idle recreation and observer creation retain revision 23 and four terminal attempts; restored-before-run records zero connections to the restored controller before explicit Run.
Restored completion and subsequent observer close export the same revision-34 journal bytes. The close is a completed-state observer test, not active-worker cancellation.
SFTP version 3 collision response is generic FAILURE; follow-up exact length/hash confirms unchanged retained payload. This does not classify every future FAILURE as already-exists.
hmac-sha2-256 is the negotiated proposal field. AES-GCM authenticates with its own tag; a separate MAC was not used.
Host command completion/capture timestamps and device event timestamps use separate clocks; no clock synchronization, network latency, throughput or timing benchmark is claimed.

privacy.published: Allowlisted build/backend identities, generated attempt/process/window/task IDs, state/events, source/artifact hashes, finite fixture payload hashes and control bounds.
privacy.excluded: Endpoints, ports, usernames, active device user, serial/Android ID, raw logs/layouts/screenshots, private or public key material, actual fixture host-key fingerprints, private-key digests and config/endpoint identity hashes.
